experiment.title: Four-pump colour matching: hit a target colour with cyan / magenta / yellow dyes and water
experiment.goal:
Use four pumps to deliver the cyan (cyan_stock), magenta (magenta_stock) and yellow (yellow_stock) dye stocks and water (water) into the beaker mix,
making 20.0 mL of mixture whose absorbance in a 1 cm cuvette is close to the target: A(470 nm) = 0.40, A(574 nm) = 0.45, A(640 nm) = 0.70.
All three dye stocks are 1.00×10⁻⁴ M; absorption bands (center / molar absorptivity / FWHM):
yellow 430 nm / 25000 / 90 nm; magenta 540 nm / 30000 / 90 nm; cyan 630 nm / 35000 / 100 nm (Gaussian band shapes, absorbances add linearly per Beer–Lambert).
Pumps: pump_1 (NE-1000, 60 mL syringe), pump_2 (NE-1000), cavro_1 / cavro_2 (Cavro XLP 6000, 5 mL syringe, built-in switching valve, at most 5 mL per push).
For each pump, first use connect_tube to connect in to its stock and out to mix; put mix on stirrer_1 and stir (no heating); insert the immersion optical probe optrode_1 (1 cm path, selectable 470/502/520/574/590/610/640/660 nm)
into mix with attach_probe and read the absorbance at the three wavelengths directly in the beaker (no cuvette needed).
When done, submit the root-mean-square deviation of the three absorbances from the target with submit_result: quantity = "color_rmse", unit = "AU".
